name: מִיכָיָהוּ
summary: The longer name preserves the divine name. Judges calls the same Ephraimite Micaiahu and Micah. Other bearers include Imlah’s son, who speaks to Ahab, and Micah of Moresheth, whose book ends by asking who is a God like Yahweh.
note: The shorter Hebrew spellings overlap in the genealogies. Chronicles also calls Abijah’s mother Micaiah in 2 Chronicles 13:2, where the relationship to the Maacah tradition requires care.
